spans.s:
लव लव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. लू), the act of
cutting, reaping (of corn), mowing, plucking or
gathering (of flowers, &c.); that which is cut or
shorn off, a shorn fleece, wool, hair; anything cut
off, a section, fragment, fraction, piece, particle, bit,
drop, small piece, small quantity, little, (जल-ल्˚, a
drop of water; तृण-ल्˚, a piece of straw; अपरा-
ध-ल्˚, a little blame); a minute division of time,
the sixtieth of a twinkling, half a second, a moment,
an instant, (according to others (1/4000) or (1/5400) or
(1/20250) of a Muhūrta); a degree (in astronomy);
the numerator of a fraction; loss, destruction; sport
[cf. लल]; N. of a son of Rāma-candra and Sītā,
(he and Rāma's other son Kuśa were the two rhap-
sodists who first committed the Rāmāyaṇa to memory
and recited it at assemblies, see Rāmāyaṇa

. and
cf. कुशीलव); N. of a king of Kaśmīra (father of
Kuśa); a kind of quail, Perdix Chinensis; (अम्),
ind. a little; लवम् अपि, even a little; (अम्), n.
nutmeg; cloves; the root of Andropogon Muricatus.
—लव-राज, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
—लव-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, lasting only for a moment.
—लव-
शस्, ind. in small pieces or fragments, bit by bit,
piecemeal, in minute divisions or instants, after an
instant, after some moments.
—लवेप्सु (˚व-ईप्˚),
उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to cut or reap.
लव, लवक, लवनीय, &c. See p. 863, col. 3.
लाव लाव. See p. 870, col. 3.

लाव, अस्, ई, अम्, cutting, severing, dividing, reap-
ing; plucking, gathering, (कुसुम-लावी, a female
gatherer of flowers); cutting off; cutting to pieces,
destroying, killing [cf. शत्रु-ल्˚]; = लाब, a quail,
q. v.

लवक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who cuts or reaps, &c.,
a cutter, reaper, shearer; N. of a particular substance,
(see स-ल्˚.)

लवाक, अस्, m. an implement for cutting, sickle,
reaping-hook; the act of cutting.

लावक, अस्, m. a cutter, divider, reaper; = ला-
बक, a quail, q. v.

लवङ्ग, अस्, m. the clove tree; (अम्), n. cloves.
—लवङ्ग-कलिका, f. cloves.

लवङ्गक, अम्, n. cloves; (इका), f., N. of a
woman.

लवन, अस्, ई, अम्, one who cuts, &c., a cutter,
reaper; (ई), f. a particular fruit tree, Anona Reticu-
lata; (अम्), n. the act of cutting, reaping, mowing,
&c. (of corn); an implement for cutting, sickle,
knife, &c.
लवन लवन, &c. See p. 863, col. 3.

लवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut, to be reaped or
mown.
लवन्य, अस्, m., N. of a particular tribe of men.

लवय, Nom. P. लवयति, &c., = लवम् आच-
ष्टे, Pāṇ.
Vārtt. 2

लवाणक, अस्, m. an implement for cutting, a
sickle, reaping-hook.

लावाणक लावाणक, अस्, m., N. of a district
adjacent to Magadha, (sometimes incorrectly written
लावानक); N. of the third Lambaka of the Kathā-
sarit-sāgara.

लवि, इस्, इस्, इ, cutting, sharp, edged (as a tool or
instrument); (इस्), m. = लवित्र.

लवित्र, अम्, n. an implement for cutting, a
sickle, reaping-hook, scythe.

लव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut, to be mown or
hewn down.
लव्य लव्य. See col. 1.
लाव्य लाव्य. See p. 870, col. 3.

लाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut, to be reaped, to be
cut through.
लवट लवट, अस्, m. a proper N.

लवण लवण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt.
1. लू; according to others for original रवण),
salt, (especially) sea-salt, rock or fossil salt, (गो-ल-
वण, as much salt as is given to a cow); factitious
salt or salt obtained from saline earth; (अस्), m. salt-
ness, saline taste; the sea of salt water; N. of a
hell; of a Rākṣasa or Daitya; of a king belonging
to the family of Hari-ścandra; of a son of Rāma;
of a river; = बल, अस्थि-भेद (?) ; (आ), f. lustre,
beauty [cf. लावण्य]; a species of plant (= महा-
ज्योतिष्मती); N. of a small river in Tirhut; (ई),
f., N. of several rivers; (अस्, आ, अम्), saline, salt,
briny, brinish; handsome, beautiful.
—लवण-किं-
शुका, f. a species of plant.
—लवण-क्षार, अस्,
m. a kind of salt (= लोणार).
—लवण-खानि, इस्,
f. a salt-mine; the district of Sambher in Ajmere
celebrated for its fossil salt.
—लवण-जल, अस्, आ,
अम्, having salt water; (अस्), m. the sea, ocean.
—लवण-जल-धि or लवण-जल-निधि, इस्, m.
‘receptacle of salt water,’ the sea, ocean.
—लवण-
जलोद्भव (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the
sea; (अस्), m. a muscle, shell.
—लवण-ता, f. or
लवण-त्व, अम्, n. saltness, brinishness.
—लवण-
तृण, अम्, n. a kind of grass.
—लवण-तोय, अस्,
आ, अम्, having salt water; (अस्), m. the sea, ocean.
—लवण-धेनु, उस्, f. an offering of salt, (see
धेनु.) -लवण-पाटलिका, f. a salt-bag.
—ल-
वण-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—लवण-प्र-
गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, strongly impregnated with salt.
—लवण-मद, अस्, m. = लवण-क्षार.
—ल-
वण-मन्त्र, अस्, m. a prayer accompanied with
an offering of salt.
—लवण-मेह, अस्, m. a kind
of urinary disease (discharging salty urine).
—ल-
वण-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from the above
disease.
—लवण-वारि, इस्, इस्, इ, having salt water;
(इ), n. the sea, ocean.
—लवण-समुद्र, अस्, m.
the sea of salt water, salt-sea, sea, ocean.
—लवण-
स्थान, अम्, n., N. of a place.
—लवणाकर (˚ण-
आक्˚), अस्, m. a salt-mine; (metaphorically) a mine
of grace or beauty.
—लवणान्तक (˚ण-अन्˚), अस्,
m. the slayer of the Rākṣasa Lavaṇa, N. of Śatru-
ghna.
—लवणाब्धि (˚ण-अब्˚), इस्, m. ‘receptacle
of salt water, ‘the sea, ocean.
—लवणाब्धि-ज,
अम्, n. ‘produced from the sea,’ sea-salt.
—लव-
णाम्बु-राशि (˚ण-अम्˚), इस्, m. ‘a mass of salt water,’
the sea, ocean.
—लवणाम्भस् (˚ण-अम्˚), अस्, n.
salt water; (आस्), m. ‘having salt water,’ the sea,
ocean.
—लवणार्णव (˚ण-अर्˚) or लवणालय
(˚ण-आल्˚), अस्, m. the sea of salt water, ocean.
—ल-
वणाश्व (˚ण-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
—ल-
वणोत्तम (˚ण-उत्˚), अम्, n. ‘best salt,’ river or
rock salt; nitre.
—लवणोत्थ (˚ण-उत्˚), अम्, n. a
kind of salt (= लोणार).
—लवणोत्स (˚ण-उत्˚),
अम्, n., N. of a town.
—लवणोद (˚ण-उद),
अम्, n. salt water, brine; (अस्), m. ‘containing salt
water, ‘the sea of salt water, ocean.
—लवणोदक
(˚ण-उद्˚), अम्, n. salt water, brine; (अस्, आ, अम्),
having or containing salt water; (अस्), m. the sea,
ocean.
—लवणोदधि (˚ण-उद्˚), इस्, m. ‘receptacle
of salt water,’ the sea, ocean.

लावण लावण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. लवण), saline,
salt, salted, cooked or dressed with salt.

लवणय, Nom. P. लवणयति, to salt, season
with salt.

लवणस्य, Nom. P. लवणस्यति, to desire salt,
long for salt.
लवणारज, अम्, n. a kind of salt (= लोणार).

लवणिमन्, आ, m. saltness; grace, beauty, loveli-
ness.

लवणीय, Nom. P. लवणीयति, &c., (probably)
to wish for salt (Pāṇ.

लवली लवली, f. Averrhoa Acida; a kind
of metre.
—लवली-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of the
above.
लवेरणि लवेरणि, इस्, m. a proper N.
लावेरणि लावेरणि, इस्, m. a patronymic.

लावणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to salt, impregnated
with salt, prepared or dressed with salt, salted; deal-
ing in salt; lovely, beautiful, graceful; (अस्), m. a
dealer in salt, salt merchant; (अम्), n. a vessel holding
salt, salt-cellar.

लावण्य, अम्, n. saltness, the taste or property of
salt; beauty, loveliness, charm.
—लावण्य-कलित,
अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with beauty.
—लावण्य-मञ्-
जरी, f., N. of a woman.
—लावण्य-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, full of taste, full of loveliness or beauty, lovely,
beautiful, handsome.
—लावण्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessed of beauty or grace, beautiful, lovely; (अती),
f., N. of various women.
—लावण्य-श्री, ईस्, f.
‘wealth of beauty,’ great beauty.
—लावण्यार्जित
(˚य-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, obtained through beauty;
(अम्), n. the private property of a married woman
(consisting of that which has been presented to her
at her marriage as a token of respect or kindness or
by her father or mother-in-law).
लाविक लाविक, अस्, m. = लालिक, a buffalo.

लावु लावु, लावू, &c. See लाबु, &c., p. 865,
col. 3.
लावेरणीय, see Gaṇa Gahādi to Pāṇ.

लवित्वा, ind. having cut, having cut off or
gathered. See लूत्वा below.

लाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, cutting, reaping; gathering,
plucking; [cf. पुष्प-ल्˚.]
